{
  "dataset_name": "qsar_biodegradation",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "l2_norm_standardized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "L2 norm of z-score standardized key continuous features (V1, V2, V8, V12, V13, V14, V15, V27, V30, V31, V36, V37, V39) using training-set mean and std. Captures overall molecular descriptor magnitude in normalized space.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 20.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a single scalar summarizing how far a sample lies from the feature-space origin in standardized coordinates, improving KNN neighborhood geometry.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((V1 - 4.782643601895735) / 0.5466566715794174) ** 2 + ((V2 - 3.0695077725118485) / 0.8309140907431479) ** 2 + ((V8 - 37.055639810426534) / 9.140130976024855) ** 2 + ((V12 - (-0.19712890995260665)) / 0.7692975145200193) ** 2 + ((V13 - 3.4768436018957343) / 0.583873161252192) ** 2 + ((V14 - 1.3507156398104267) / 0.7857936843726514) ** 2 + ((V15 - 9.93738104265403) / 0.9282373577093599) ** 2 + ((V27 - 2.215640758293839) / 0.22602403270992702) ** 2 + ((V30 - 8.780509952606637) / 11.890249999789066) ** 2 + ((V31 - 2.668344075829384) / 2.095613373340077) ** 2 + ((V36 - 3.918239810426541) / 0.999128375741245) ** 2 + ((V37 - 2.5584170616113746) / 0.6424602110186098) ** 2 + ((V39 - 8.629491943127963) / 1.2413975970698978) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "mahalanobis_approx_diagonal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Diagonal Mahalanobis-like distance approximation using variance-normalized squared deviations for all continuous features. Approximates true Mahalanobis distance assuming diagonal covariance.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 150.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Variance-normalized distance metric that accounts for feature scale differences, improving KNN distance calculations in heterogeneous feature spaces.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((V1 - 4.782643601895735) ** 2 / (0.5466566715794174 ** 2)) + ((V2 - 3.0695077725118485) ** 2 / (0.8309140907431479 ** 2)) + ((V8 - 37.055639810426534) ** 2 / (9.140130976024855 ** 2)) + ((V12 - (-0.19712890995260665)) ** 2 / (0.7692975145200193 ** 2)) + ((V13 - 3.4768436018957343) ** 2 / (0.583873161252192 ** 2)) + ((V15 - 9.93738104265403) ** 2 / (0.9282373577093599 ** 2)) + ((V27 - 2.215640758293839) ** 2 / (0.22602403270992702 ** 2)) + ((V30 - 8.780509952606637) ** 2 / (11.890249999789066 ** 2)) + ((V31 - 2.668344075829384) ** 2 / (2.095613373340077 ** 2)) + ((V36 - 3.918239810426541) ** 2 / (0.999128375741245 ** 2)) + ((V37 - 2.5584170616113746) ** 2 / (0.6424602110186098 ** 2)) + ((V39 - 8.629491943127963) ** 2 / (1.2413975970698978 ** 2))"
    },
    {
      "name": "dist_to_global_centroid",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Euclidean distance from the sample to the global training centroid in the standardized space of V1, V13, V15, V36, V37, V39 (key continuous molecular descriptors).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "prototype_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures how atypical a sample is relative to the overall dataset center, helping KNN identify outliers and boundary samples.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.sqrt(((V1 - 4.782643601895735) / 0.5466566715794174) ** 2 + ((V13 - 3.4768436018957343) / 0.583873161252192) ** 2 + ((V15 - 9.93738104265403) / 0.9282373577093599) ** 2 + ((V36 - 3.918239810426541) / 0.999128375741245) ** 2 + ((V37 - 2.5584170616113746) / 0.6424602110186098) ** 2 + ((V39 - 8.629491943127963) / 1.2413975970698978) ** 2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "count_feature_outlier_flags",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of features where the standardized value exceeds 2 standard deviations from the training mean, across V1, V2, V8, V12, V13, V15, V30, V31, V36, V37, V39.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 11.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Indicates how many features are extreme, helping KNN identify samples that may be in sparse regions of the feature space with fewer reliable neighbors.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(np.abs((V1 - 4.782643601895735) / 0.5466566715794174) > 2, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs((V2 - 3.0695077725118485) / 0.8309140907431479) > 2, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs((V8 - 37.055639810426534) / 9.140130976024855) > 2, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs((V12 - (-0.19712890995260665)) / 0.7692975145200193) > 2, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs((V13 - 3.4768436018957343) / 0.583873161252192) > 2, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs((V15 - 9.93738104265403) / 0.9282373577093599) > 2, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs((V30 - 8.780509952606637) / 11.890249999789066) > 2, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs((V31 - 2.668344075829384) / 2.095613373340077) > 2, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs((V36 - 3.918239810426541) / 0.999128375741245) > 2, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs((V37 - 2.5584170616113746) / 0.6424602110186098) > 2, 1, 0) + np.where(np.abs((V39 - 8.629491943127963) / 1.2413975970698978) > 2, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "molecular_complexity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite molecular complexity score combining count-based features (V3, V5, V7, V9, V10, V11, V16) normalized by their training means. Captures structural richness of the molecule.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 30.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Summarizes molecular structural complexity in a single normalized score, improving KNN neighborhood coherence for structurally similar molecules.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(V3 / np.maximum(0.7165876777251184, 0.001)) + np.log1p(V5 / np.maximum(0.9800947867298578, 0.001)) + np.log1p(V7 / np.maximum(1.6464454976303318, 0.001)) + np.log1p(V9 / np.maximum(1.376303317535545, 0.001)) + np.log1p(V10 / np.maximum(1.8037914691943129, 0.001)) + np.log1p(V11 / np.maximum(1.4369668246445497, 0.001)) + np.log1p(V16 / np.maximum(3.6303317535545023, 0.001))"
    },
    {
      "name": "ratio_v1_v13",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of V1 (mean first ionization potential proxy) to V13 (another topological descriptor), normalized by training-set ratio mean. Captures relative molecular electronic structure.",
      "value_range": [0.2, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ratio features capture relative relationships between descriptors that may define molecular similarity clusters better than raw values for KNN.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 / np.maximum(V13, 0.001)"
    },
    {
      "name": "topological_distance_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite topological distance index combining V36, V37, V39 (topological/geometric descriptors) standardized and summed. Represents molecular shape and connectivity.",
      "value_range": [-8.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates topological descriptors into a single index that captures molecular shape similarity, improving KNN distance calculations for structurally related compounds.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((V36 - 3.918239810426541) / 0.999128375741245) + ((V37 - 2.5584170616113746) / 0.6424602110186098) + ((V39 - 8.629491943127963) / 1.2413975970698978)"
    },
    {
      "name": "electronic_descriptor_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite of electronic/physicochemical descriptors V12, V14, V17, V18, V22, V27, V28 standardized and combined. Captures electronic properties of the molecule.",
      "value_range": [-15.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates electronic descriptors into a single feature that captures electronic similarity between molecules, improving KNN neighborhood quality.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((V12 - (-0.19712890995260665)) / 0.7692975145200193) + ((V14 - 1.3507156398104267) / 0.7857936843726514) + ((V17 - 1.0133023696682464) / 0.04647227725888176) + ((V18 - 1.1311061611374407) / 0.030128667363683293) + ((V22 - 1.2387270142180093) / 0.09641998072264016) + ((V27 - 2.215640758293839) / 0.22602403270992702) + ((V28 - (-0.001205687203791469)) / 0.15885309427289346)"
    },
    {
      "name": "sparse_feature_density",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Proportion of sparse/count features (V4, V6, V19, V20, V21, V24, V25, V26, V29, V32, V40) that are non-zero. Indicates how many rare structural features are present.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the density of rare structural features, helping KNN identify samples in sparse regions where neighborhood distances may be less reliable.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(V4 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V6 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V19 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V20 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V21 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V24 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V25 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V26 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V29 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V32 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(V40 > 0, 1, 0)) / 11.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_transformed_v30",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log1p transformation of V30 (highly skewed feature with large range 0-71), standardized by training log-mean. Reduces skewness for better KNN distance calculations.",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized_distance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Log transformation of skewed V30 reduces the influence of extreme values on KNN distances, improving neighborhood quality for typical samples.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(V30) - np.log1p(8.780509952606637)) / np.maximum(np.log1p(8.780509952606637 + 11.890249999789066) - np.log1p(8.780509952606637), 0.001)"
    },
    {
      "name": "molecular_descriptor_coherence",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of how internally coherent the molecular descriptor profile is, based on whether key descriptor ratios (V1/V2, V13/V15, V36/V39) fall within typical ranges seen in drug-like molecules. Score from 0 (incoherent/atypical) to 1 (highly coherent/typical).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "similarity_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Coherent descriptor profiles indicate samples that are more likely to have reliable KNN neighbors, improving distance-based predictions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "structural_complexity_balance",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of the balance between molecular size indicators (V7, V9, V10, V16) and connectivity descriptors (V33, V34, V35, V38). Score from 0 (highly imbalanced, unusual structure) to 1 (well-balanced, typical structure). Considers whether atom counts and bond counts are proportionally consistent.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "cluster_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Structurally balanced molecules tend to cluster together in descriptor space, helping KNN identify coherent neighborhoods of similar compounds.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
